mapper.insert: INSERT INTO DH_FLAG (FLAG, EVENT_ID, DEVICE_ID) SELECT #{flag} AS FLAG, #{eventId} AS EVENT_ID, d.ID AS DEVICE_ID FROM DH_DEVICE d WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM DH_FLAG f WHERE f.EVENT_ID = #{eventId} AND f.DEVICE_ID = d.ID )
mapper.select: SELECT id, parent_id, name, '1' AS type FROM DH_STATION UNION ALL SELECT d.id, d.parent_id, d.name, '2' AS type FROM DH_DEVICE d
